title: Decree of Unity resolves as a no-op: no target prompt and nothing is killed
expected: packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json:3889-3891 — ven-131-166 "Decree of Unity" has rulesText "Kill an enemy Chaos unit or gear." but `"abilities": []` and `"parseSuccess": false`. No other definition of the card exists anywhere in packages/ or apps/riftbound-app (grep for id/name/slug returns only this JSON entry), so the engine has no effect/targeting to enumerate; the spell resolves with an empty payload, matching the observed no-target, no-kill behavior.
observed: playSpell was enumerated with no targets param (unlike Cleave/Blood Rush which listed per-target moves); cost was paid (energy 22->20, order 1->0), spell went on chain with no effect payload, and on passChainPriority it went to trash (trash 0->1) with no pendingChoice and all four permanents still in base. Card data in packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/sets/ven.json has abilities: [] and parseSuccess: false, so the spell text was never converted into an effect
